verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint that accepts live audio input. The official docs only cover uploading a completed file, with the option to "stream text while the model processes the file"; that is output streaming over a bounded file, not live audio streaming. The real-time captioning reports come from third-party ports and apps (whisper.cpp's streaming sample, Buzz), which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time
